description: Buddy Phase 38 — Execution & Data Pipeline Hardening. ExecutionManager (2867 lines, minimal tests) is the trade execution backbone. modular_data_loaders.py (3842 lines, 0 tests) is the feature engineering pipeline. Both are financial-critical with insufficient coverage. Target: 60+ new tests hardening execution safety and data pipeline correctness.

userStories.title: Unit tests for ExecutionManager position sizing and risk checks
userStories.description: execution.py ExecutionManager handles position sizing, risk limits, and spread conditions. Test calculate_position_size, can_trade, _check_portfolio_risk_limit, _check_correlation_exposure, _check_spread_conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: Test with mock OANDA client (no real API calls)
userStories.notes: 45 tests in test_execution_manager_core.py. Covers: ExecutionConfig defaults (9), ExecutionResult (5), init (3), can_trade (3), portfolio risk limit (5), spread conditions (5), TP calculation (5), risk manager (4), correlation exposure (2), OANDA client init (2), slippage tracking (2). All passing.

userStories.title: Unit tests for ExecutionManager trade logging and journal sync
userStories.description: Test _log_trade, _append_journal_entry, sync_journal, fetch_actual_win_rate. These are financial record-keeping paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Test with temp journal files (no OANDA)
userStories.notes: 15 tests in test_execution_journal.py. Covers: _append_journal_entry (4), _log_trade (3), fetch_actual_win_rate (4), sync_journal (2), execution_quality_summary (1), win_rate_by_pair (1). Local import patching pattern discovered (Path, TradeJournal). All passing.

userStories.title: Unit tests for ExecutionConfig and ExecutionResult dataclasses
userStories.description: Test ExecutionConfig defaults, validation, and ExecutionResult construction. These are the data contracts for the execution pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover: ExecutionConfig defaults, ExecutionResult fields, validation
userStories.notes: Combined with US-242 in test_execution_manager_core.py. ExecutionConfig (9 tests) + ExecutionResult (5 tests) = 14 tests for dataclasses alone. All passing.

userStories.title: Unit tests for compute_normalized_features
userStories.description: modular_data_loaders.py compute_normalized_features is the core feature engineering function (400+ lines). Test with various OHLCV inputs, edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover: compute_normalized_features with valid OHLCV, missing columns, single row, NaN handling
Verify output feature names and shapes
userStories.notes: 10 tests in test_data_loaders_core.py. Covers: output columns, output shape, NaN-free core features, returns reasonableness, z-score clipping, input immutability, missing volume handling, multi-period returns, multi-period ATR, small dataframe edge case. All passing.

userStories.title: Unit tests for regime classification and volatility detection
acceptanceCriteria: Cover: classify_market_regime, compute_volatility_regime, fast indicator helpers
userStories.notes: 14 tests in test_data_loaders_core.py. Covers: RSI (3), ADX (3), ATR% (2), classify_market_regime tuple return (4), compute_volatility_regime (2), VolatilityRegimeConfig (1), RegimeConfig (1). Key discovery: classify_market_regime returns (regimes, confidence) tuple. All passing.

userStories.title: Unit tests for data loading and feature alignment
userStories.description: Test temporal_split, align_features_to_model, get_normalized_feature_names, pair normalization functions.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover: temporal_split, align_features_to_model, normalization stats functions
userStories.notes: 5 tests in test_data_loaders_core.py. Covers: temporal_split (3 — basic split, total preservation, temporal ordering), get_normalized_feature_names (2 — returns dict, has categories). Key discovery: temporal_split takes n_samples:int not DataFrame. All passing.
